Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: an analytics dashboard (Leads Report) - dark CRM with a left nav (favorites: Apple, Google, ClickUp, Rico, Mehdi; saved searches), KPI cards (Pipeline Value $485,000, Lead-to-Deal 18.5%, Contacted 92) with red/green delta chips, a Sales Revenue bar chart whose hovered bar ignites orange (MAY $1,631,241) while others stay ghost-grey, growth-badge tooltips (3m/6m/1y), and Leads-by-Status progress bars.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark dashboard (#111). Sidebar: nav + favorites avatars + saved searches. Main: KPI card row with delta chips (red down / green up); Sales Revenue bar chart (bars flat #2A2A2C); readout panel with value + delta caption + growth badges; Leads-by-Status progress bars.

## Motion spec
Pattern: hover-driven chart scrub.
- Bar hover: the hovered bar ignites - fill grey -> orange gradient over 150ms ease-out; other bars stay ghost-grey; the readout swaps to that bar's value (MAY $1,631,241) + caption ("12.5% down vs Yesterday") with a 150ms crossfade; growth badges (3m +25%, 6m +25%, 1y 12.5%) appear on the right (fade, 150ms).
- Un-hover: everything returns (150ms).
- Sidebar, KPI cards, progress bars: static.

## Calibration
- Highlight 150ms ease-out - the bar should feel lit by the cursor, with no perceptible delay.
- Only ONE bar is hot at a time; the ghost-grey rest are what make the orange read.
- Delta chips are small and colored (red/green text+dot, no filled badges).

## Reduced motion
Highlight applies instantly without transition; readout swaps without fade.

## Don't miss
- The orange is a gradient (hot top), not a flat fill - it's an ignition, not a selection.
- Growth badges appear contextually with the hover, right-aligned.
- Numbers are tabular-nums with de-emphasized decimals where present (dashboard convention).
